Thorne is only running around 200 active Facebook ads with videos, subscribe and save offers, UDC, and mainly product focused shots. But they're missing flavor swatches, they're missing visual education, they're missing tons of comparisons in product breakdown images, and most of the website is just text based. There's so much more they could be doing on their product pages to educate customers, overcome objections, and increase their conversion rates and Aovs. But Thorne isn't only focus on direct to consumer marketing. So while Mars Men has built an aggressive direct response, advertising and conversion funnel, Thorne has built a massive trust and distribution network. Let me know who you think is winning.
